---
title: "Validate API Key"
api: "POST /auth/validate"
description: "Validate API key and get access information"
---

Validate an API key and retrieve access information including permissions, rate limits, and usage statistics. This endpoint is used to verify API key validity and get detailed information about the key's capabilities.

<Note>
  **External API Endpoint**
  
  This endpoint is part of the External API category and uses Basic Authentication. It's designed for API key validation and access management.
</Note>

## Authentication

This endpoint uses Basic Authentication. Include your API credentials in the Authorization header:

```bash
Authorization: Basic <base64_encoded_credentials>
```

Where credentials are encoded as `base64(api_key:api_secret)`.

## Request

<ParamField body="api_key" type="string" required="false">
  API key to validate (alternative to Basic Auth)
  
  **Example**: "ak_1234567890abcdef"
  
  **Note**: If provided, will override Basic Auth credentials
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="include_usage" type="boolean" required="false">
  Whether to include usage statistics in the response
  
  **Example**: true
  
  **Default**: false
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="include_permissions" type="boolean" required="false">
  Whether to include detailed permissions in the response
  
  **Example**: true
  
  **Default**: true
</ParamField>

## Response

<ResponseField name="success" type="boolean">
  Indicates if the request was successful
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data" type="object">
  API key validation result
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data.api_key_id" type="string">
  Unique identifier for the API key
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data.api_key" type="string">
  API key (masked for security)
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data.name" type="string">
  Human-readable name for the API key
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data.description" type="string">
  Description of the API key's purpose
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data.status" type="string">
  Current status of the API key
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data.permissions" type="array">
  List of permissions granted to the API key
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data.rate_limits" type="object">
  Rate limiting information
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data.rate_limits.requests_per_hour" type="integer">
  Maximum requests per hour
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data.rate_limits.requests_per_day" type="integer">
  Maximum requests per day
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data.rate_limits.burst_limit" type="integer">
  Maximum burst requests
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data.usage" type="object">
  Usage statistics (if requested)
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data.usage.requests_today" type="integer">
  Number of requests made today
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data.usage.requests_this_month" type="integer">
  Number of requests made this month
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data.usage.last_used" type="string">
  ISO 8601 timestamp of last API usage
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data.created_at" type="string">
  ISO 8601 timestamp when the API key was created
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data.expires_at" type="string">
  ISO 8601 timestamp when the API key expires
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data.organization_id" type="string">
  Organization ID the API key belongs to
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data.organization_name" type="string">
  Organization name
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="message" type="string">
  Human-readable message about the operation result
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="timestamp" type="string">
  ISO 8601 timestamp of the response
</ResponseField>

## Example Request

<CodeGroup>
```bash cURL
curl -X POST "https://external.example.com/auth/validate" \
  -H "Authorization: Basic $(echo -n 'ak_1234567890abcdef:sk_0987654321fedcba' | base64)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "include_usage": true,
    "include_permissions": true
  }'
```

```javascript JavaScript
const apiKey = 'ak_1234567890abcdef';
const apiSecret = 'sk_0987654321fedcba';
const credentials = btoa(`${apiKey}:${apiSecret}`);

const response = await fetch('https://external.example.com/auth/validate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Basic ${credentials}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    include_usage: true,
    include_permissions: true
  })
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```python Python
import requests
import base64

api_key = 'ak_1234567890abcdef'
api_secret = 'sk_0987654321fedcba'
credentials = base64.b64encode(f'{api_key}:{api_secret}'.encode()).decode()

response = requests.post(
    'https://external.example.com/auth/validate',
    headers={
        'Authorization': f'Basic {credentials}',
        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
    },
    json={
        'include_usage': True,
        'include_permissions': True
    }
)

print(response.json())
```
</CodeGroup>

## Usage Notes

<AccordionGroup>
  <Accordion title="API Key Status" icon="info">
    API key statuses:
    
    - **active**: Key is valid and ready for use
    - **inactive**: Key is disabled but not deleted
    - **expired**: Key has passed expiration date
    - **suspended**: Key is temporarily suspended
  </Accordion>
  
  <Accordion title="Permissions" icon="shield">

## Code Examples

<AccordionGroup>
  <Accordion title="API Key Validator" icon="cog">
    ```javascript
class APIKeyValidator {
  constructor(apiKey, apiSecret) {
    this.apiKey = apiKey;
    this.apiSecret = apiSecret;
    this.baseUrl = 'https://external.example.com';
  }
  
  async validateKey(includeUsage = false, includePermissions = true) {
    try {
      const credentials = btoa(`${this.apiKey}:${this.apiSecret}`);
      
      const response = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/auth/validate`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Authorization': `Basic ${credentials}`,
          'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          include_usage: includeUsage,
          include_permissions: includePermissions
        })
      });
      
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`API key validation failed: ${response.status}`);
      }
      
      const result = await response.json();
      return result;
      
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error validating API key:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }
  
  async checkRateLimits() {
    const result = await this.validateKey(true, true);
    return result.data.rate_limits;
  }
  
  async getUsageStats() {
    const result = await this.validateKey(true, false);
    return result.data.usage;
  }
  
  async hasPermission(permission) {
    const result = await this.validateKey(false, true);
    return result.data.permissions.includes(permission);
  }
}
```
  </Accordion>
  
  <Accordion title="Python API Client" icon="python">
    ```python
import requests
import base64
from typing import Dict, List, Optional

class ExternalAPIClient:
    def __init__(self, api_key: str, api_secret: str, base_url: str = "https://external.example.com"):
        self.api_key = api_key
        self.api_secret = api_secret
        self.base_url = base_url
        self.credentials = base64.b64encode(f'{api_key}:{api_secret}'.encode()).decode()
    
    def validate_api_key(self, 
                        include_usage: bool = False, 
                        include_permissions: bool = True) -> Dict:
        """Validate API key and get access information"""
        try:
            payload = {
                "include_usage": include_usage,
                "include_permissions": include_permissions
            }
            
            response = requests.post(
                f"{self.base_url}/auth/validate",
                headers={
                    'Authorization': f'Basic {self.credentials}',
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                },
                json=payload
            )
            
            response.raise_for_status()
            return response.json()
            
        except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:
            print(f"API key validation failed: {e}")
            raise
    
    def check_permissions(self) -> List[str]:
        """Get list of API key permissions"""
        result = self.validate_api_key(include_permissions=True)
        return result.get("data", {}).get("permissions", [])
    
    def has_permission(self, permission: str) -> bool:
        """Check if API key has specific permission"""
        permissions = self.check_permissions()
        return permission in permissions
    
    def get_rate_limits(self) -> Dict:
        """Get API key rate limits"""
        result = self.validate_api_key(include_permissions=True)
        return result.get("data", {}).get("rate_limits", {})
    
    def get_usage_stats(self) -> Dict:
        """Get API key usage statistics"""
        result = self.validate_api_key(include_usage=True)
        return result.get("data", {}).get("usage", {})
    
    def is_key_valid(self) -> bool:
        """Check if API key is valid and active"""
        try:
            result = self.validate_api_key()
            return result.get("success", False) and result.get("data", {}).get("status") == "active"
        except:
            return False
```
